metadata.name: Showcase
metadata.description: Synthetic every-feature reference app for the Sprigr app kit: exercises every manifest field family and every env.SPRIGR.* runtime call so authors can copy one capability at a time. Provider persona is the fictional Acme CRM.

sync_window_days.title: Backfill window (days)
sync_window_days.description: How many days of Acme CRM history the durable backfill job walks on first connect.

notify_on_high_value.title: Notify on high-value deals
notify_on_high_value.description: Append an inbox message when a webhook reports a deal over the threshold.

decision_route_workflow_id.title: Routing workflow id
decision_route_workflow_id.description: Optional workflow the route_decision decision-point calls. Leave blank to use the built-in default routing.

data_index.description: Per-company cache of Acme CRM contacts, faceted by pipeline stage / owner / lead source for agent search.

secrets.label: Token encryption key
secrets.description: AES-GCM key that wraps the OAuth tokens this install stores in showcase_secrets. The platform mints a fresh 32-byte random value per install; neither the publisher nor the brand ever sees it. It is minted once and never regenerated, because regenerating it would make every value already sealed under it unreadable.

secrets.label: Acme CRM webhook signing secret
secrets.description: Brand-supplied HMAC signing secret from the Acme CRM webhook settings page. Verifies inbound per-install webhooks.

secrets.label: Acme CRM OAuth client id
secrets.description: Publisher-owned OAuth client id for the shared Acme CRM developer app. Seeded once with `sprigr app set-publisher-secrets`.

secrets.label: Acme CRM OAuth client secret
secrets.description: Publisher-owned OAuth client secret for the shared Acme CRM developer app.

secrets.label: Acme CRM shared (app-level) webhook secret
secrets.description: Publisher-owned secret the platform uses to verify + re-sign the single app-level Acme CRM webhook before per-tenant fan-out.

secrets.label: OAuth state signing key
secrets.description: Per-install random key used to sign the OAuth `state` blob. Server-minted; never seen by the brand or publisher.

migrations.description: Initial schema: settings + secrets key-value tables, webhook dedup + sync-cursor tables.
Adds the install_config table for the app_installations.config override pattern.

rules.text: Use Acme CRM contact data to answer questions and draft outreach the user asks for.
Never paste more than 25 contact records into a single reply; summarise instead.
Do not repeat a contact's phone number or email address into a public team room; use the private chat channel.

tools.name: showcase
tools.description: Acme CRM dispatcher. Actions: list_contacts (faceted, optionally by stage), get_contact (by id), search_cached_contacts (queries the per-company data index), cache_contact (writes one contact to the data index), connection_status.

action.description: Which Acme CRM operation to run.

contact_id.description: Acme contact id. Required for get_contact / cache_contact.

tools.name: showcase_oauth_callback
tools.description: Dispatched by the publisher-shared OAuth bouncer after Acme redirects with a code. Verifies csrf, exchanges the code, persists tokens to per-install D1.

tools.name: showcase_inbound_import
tools.description: Provider-initiated (inbound) install target. The platform dispatches the exchanged Acme token here after a workspace-initiated connect; the app persists it and kicks off backfill.

tools.name: refresh_showcase_tokens
tools.description: Scheduled keep-warm refresh of the stored Acme OAuth tokens. Not for direct agent use.

tools.name: showcase_webhook_contact
tools.description: Per-install webhook receiver for Acme contact.updated events (hmac hex). Dedups, then caches the contact to the data index.

tools.name: showcase_webhook_deal
tools.description: Per-install webhook receiver for Acme deal.won events (hmac base64). Emits a marketplace event and optionally appends an inbox message.

tools.name: showcase_webhook_bookmarklet
tools.description: Operator-driven webhook (install_token bearer scheme) — e.g. a browser bookmarklet posts a contact id to cache.

tools.name: showcase_webhook_shared
tools.description: App-level SHARED webhook (one URL for the whole app, fanned out per tenant). Registers each tenant via env.SPRIGR.registerWebhookTenant at connect.

tools.name: showcase_channel_receive
tools.description: Inbound channel receiver: verifies the Acme Chat signature and decodes a provider event into a normalized InboundMessage (or a URL-verification challenge / ignore).

tools.name: showcase_channel_send
tools.description: Outbound channel sender: encodes + sends a normalized OutboundMessage via the Acme Chat API using the app's stored token.

tools.name: showcase_channel_identity
tools.description: Maps an Acme Chat user id to a stable sender identity for companion routing / notify defaults.

tools.name: showcase_daily_digest
tools.description: per_install schedule handler: builds a daily digest of new Acme contacts and reports usage.

tools.name: showcase_tenant_rollup
tools.description: per_tenant schedule handler: rolls up counts across every install of this app in the tenant.

tools.name: showcase_backfill_step
tools.description: Durable job STEP FUNCTION for the contact backfill. Walks Acme pages one at a time, driving continue/sleep/wait/complete/fail directives from job state. Internal — never agent-callable.

tools.name: showcase_on_deal_won
tools.description: Event subscription handler: reacts to showcase.deal.won emissions (self-subscription) by caching the winning contact.

tools.name: showcase_route_decision
tools.description: Decision-point extension: reads a tenant-configured routing workflow from install config and calls env.SPRIGR.run_workflow; falls back to built-in routing.

cross_tenant_tools.description: Look up one cached Acme CRM contact by id. Granted to a consumer app so it can read this brand's contacts.

app_dependencies.reason: Optional smoke-test ping to the hello-marketplace fixture, demonstrating an app-to-app dependency grant.

integration_dependencies.reason: When the brand also runs Shopify, the showcase app can correlate an Acme deal with a Shopify order. Optional — degrades gracefully when no Shopify integration is connected.

fulfillment_services.reason: Demonstrates registering a Shopify fulfillment location per warehouse via env.SPRIGR.fulfillment_services.register.

jobs.name: showcase_backfill
jobs.description: Durable contact backfill: pages through Acme CRM history, sleeps between pages to respect rate limits, and can wait for an operator signal before finishing.

agent_schedules.name: showcase_engagement_sync
agent_schedules.prompt: Search the Acme CRM cache for contacts that reached the 'won' stage yesterday and write a one-line knowledge note summarizing each.

emits.name: showcase.deal.won
emits.description: Fires when Acme reports a deal moved to the won stage.

emits.name: showcase.contact.cached
emits.description: Fires when a contact is written to the per-company data index.

cross_tenant_emits.description: Share won-deal signals across tenant boundaries with a granting brand's consent (e.g. a partner analytics tenant).

workflow_templates.name: Deal-won intake
workflow_templates.description: Event-triggered template: when showcase.deal.won fires, branch on deal amount.

decision_points.description: Fires inside showcase_route_decision when a new contact needs routing to an owner. The configured workflow returns { owner }; the handler assigns it. Falls back to round-robin when unconfigured.
decision_points.default_behavior: Round-robin assignment across the tenant's active owners.

optional.reason: Used only for the optional smoke-test ping.
